name: Computational Methods for Differential Equations
description:
Numerical methods for solving IVPs for ODEs: Single step method: Taylor
series method, convergence, order. Multistep methods: Development
of linear multistep method using interpolation and undetermined
parameter approach, consistency, zero stability, convergence, order. Absolute stability for linear multistep methods: motivation, Routh-Hurwitz criterion, boundary locus method etc., absolute stability for systems, stiff systems.
Linear multistep methods for nonlinear system: Predictor Corrector methods.
Numerical methods for solving BVPs for ODEs: Finite difference methods for second order ODEs.
Numerical methods for solving PDEs: Finite difference methods for PDEs on real line, Consistency, stability (von neumann analysis, energy method) and convergence. Finite difference methods for PDE on interval: incorporation of Boundary Conditions, Consistency, stability (matrix method, energy method) and convergence
